title: Weak, stable, and ordinary Lusternik-Schnirelmann category of finite spaces
summary: The weak, stable, and ordinary Lusternik--Schnirelmann categories of a finite $T_0$-space $X$ satisfy $\operatorname{cat}_w(X)\leq \operatorname{cat}_s(X)\leq \operatorname{cat}(X)$. We give a general construction answering the simultaneous-strictness question of Cárdenas, Flores, Quintero, and Villar-Liñán. If $P$ is weakly contractible but noncontractible and the deletion of one point makes $P$ contractible, then adjoining $m\geq 2$ incomparable maximal points produces a connected finite space with category triple $(1,2,m)$.
